title: Most GTA 6 players chose THIS console #gta6 #shorts
description: Sensor Tower's launch-morning estimate (third-party, not official): about 19 million copies, roughly 75% on PlayStation.

scenes.say: Three out of four GTA 6 buyers picked the same console.

scenes.label: Sales on PlayStation
scenes.say: About seventy five percent of early copies were on PlayStation, according to Sensor Tower.

scenes.label: Copies by launch morning
scenes.say: That's out of roughly nineteen million copies before launch day even started.
Xbox Series X and S got the other quarter.
So which side are you on? PlayStation or Xbox?
